---
title: "Module 3B: WGCNA Network, Module-Trait Analysis and Enrichment"
author: "Helen Hoxie"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

**Purpose.** Build a single signed co-expression network over tumor and normal
adjacent tissue (NAT) samples using the soft-thresholding power recorded in
`config/runs/<run_id>.json`, then relate module eigengenes to clinical,
mutation and expression traits and annotate modules by pathway enrichment.

The module stops before network construction if no power is recorded or if the
input fingerprint differs from the one recorded when the power was chosen
(Module 3A).

**Trait encoding.**

| Trait | Tumor samples | NAT samples |
|---|---|---|
| `Tumor_Status` | 1 | 0 |
| `Stage_I` ... `Stage_IV` | 1 / 0; `NA` if unstaged | `NA` if `stage_traits_tumor_only`, else 0 |
| `HPV_Pos` | 1 / 0; `NA` if unknown | `NA` |
| `<gene>_Mut` (config `mutations$flag_genes`) | 1 / 0; `NA` without mutation data | `NA` |
| `<gene>_Expr` (config `wgcna$expression_traits`) | log2-CPM | log2-CPM |

Correlation p-values use the number of non-missing samples for each
module-trait pair (`WGCNA::corAndPvalue`).

**Pathway enrichment** (GO BP, KEGG, Reactome) uses all network genes with an
Entrez ID as the background (one Entrez ID per Ensembl ID). KEGG and Reactome queries depend on current online
or package database versions.

**Inputs** (relative to `project_dir`): `data/processed/wgcna_datExpr.rds` (3A),
`v_mrna.rds`, `gene_annotation.rds` (Module 2), `master_samples.rds` (Module 1);
`config/runs/<run_id>.json` (repository).

**Outputs:**

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `data/processed/wgcna_net.rds` | `blockwiseModules` result |
| `data/processed/wgcna_MEs.rds` | module eigengenes (samples x modules) |
| `data/processed/wgcna_geneMap.rds` | Ensembl ID, symbol, module, kME |
| `data/processed/wgcna_traits.rds` | trait matrix |
| `results/WGCNA/run_snapshot.json` | resolved config and run record used |
| `results/WGCNA/module_trait_correlations.csv` | r, p, n per module-trait pair |
| `results/WGCNA/Trait_Heatmap.pdf`, `Trait_Heatmap_Key.pdf` | module-trait heatmaps |
| `results/WGCNA/Stage_Trajectories.pdf` | eigengenes, Normal through Stage IV |
| `results/WGCNA/HPV_Confounder.pdf`, `HPV_Effect_Sizes.csv` | eigengenes by HPV group |
| `results/WGCNA/pathways/<module>_*.txt`, `*_GO_Dotplot.pdf` | enrichment results |
| `results/WGCNA/Hub_genes.csv` | genes with kME above the configured threshold |

**References.** Langfelder & Horvath (2008) BMC Bioinformatics 9:559 (WGCNA).


```{r setup}
source(here::here("scripts", "helpers", "config.R"))
source(here::here("scripts", "helpers", "run_record.R"))
cfg <- load_config()
start_log(cfg, "Module_3B_WGCNA_Network")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(WGCNA)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(cowplot)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(ReactomePA)
})
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
allowWGCNAThreads(nThreads = cfg$compute$wgcna_threads)
set.seed(cfg$compute$seed)

wg <- cfg$wgcna
wgcna_dir <- proj_path(cfg, "results", "WGCNA")
pathway_dir <- file.path(wgcna_dir, "pathways")
dir.create(pathway_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
out_data <- function(f) proj_path(cfg, "data", "processed", f)
```


## 1. Recorded power and input check

```{r check_run_record}
datExpr <- readRDS(out_data("wgcna_datExpr.rds"))
rec <- read_run_record(cfg)

power <- require_selected_power(rec)
assert_fingerprint(rec, wgcna_fingerprint(datExpr, cfg$de$gene_types))

candidates <- read.csv(file.path(wgcna_dir, "soft_threshold_candidates.csv"))
cat("Soft-thresholding power:", power, "\n")
cat("Selected by:", rec$wgcna_power$selected_by, "on", rec$wgcna_power$selected_on, "\n")
cat("Criterion:", rec$wgcna_power$selection_criterion, "\n")
cat("Signed R^2 at this power (from 3A):",
    round(candidates$signed_R2[candidates$power == power], 3), "\n")
cat("Input fingerprint verified:", ncol(datExpr), "genes x", nrow(datExpr), "samples\n")

jsonlite::write_json(list(config = cfg, run_record = rec),
                     file.path(wgcna_dir, "run_snapshot.json"),
                     auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE, na = "null", null = "null")
```


## 2. Network construction

```{r network}
max_block <- if (is_missing(wg$max_block_size)) ncol(datExpr) + 1 else wg$max_block_size
cat("maxBlockSize:", max_block, "\n")

cor <- WGCNA::cor   # blockwiseModules requires WGCNA's cor
net <- blockwiseModules(datExpr, power = power,
                        networkType = wg$network_type, TOMType = "signed",
                        maxBlockSize = max_block,
                        minModuleSize = wg$min_module_size,
                        mergeCutHeight = wg$merge_cut_height,
                        numericLabels = TRUE, pamRespectsDendro = FALSE,
                        randomSeed = cfg$compute$seed, verbose = 0)
cor <- stats::cor

cat("Blocks:", length(unique(net$blocks)), "\n")

# Rename greenyellow before eigengenes so ME, kME and module labels agree
moduleColors <- labels2colors(net$colors)
moduleColors[moduleColors == "greenyellow"] <- "chartreuse"

MEs <- orderMEs(moduleEigengenes(datExpr, colors = moduleColors)$eigengenes)
rownames(MEs) <- rownames(datExpr)
datKME <- signedKME(datExpr, MEs)

gene_annotation <- readRDS(out_data("gene_annotation.rds"))
gene_map <- data.frame(Ensembl_ID = colnames(datExpr), Module = moduleColors) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(kME = datKME[cbind(seq_len(nrow(datKME)),
                                   match(paste0("kME", Module), colnames(datKME)))]) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_annotation[, c("Ensembl_ID", "Symbol")], by = "Ensembl_ID") %>%
  dplyr::select(Ensembl_ID, Symbol, Module, kME) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Module, dplyr::desc(kME))

module_sizes <- sort(table(moduleColors), decreasing = TRUE)
cat("Modules (excluding grey):", sum(names(module_sizes) != "grey"), "\n")
n_grey <- sum(moduleColors == "grey")
cat("Grey genes:", n_grey, "of", ncol(datExpr), sprintf("(%.1f%%)", 100 * n_grey / ncol(datExpr)), "\n")
print(module_sizes)

saveRDS(net, out_data("wgcna_net.rds"))
saveRDS(MEs, out_data("wgcna_MEs.rds"))
saveRDS(gene_map, out_data("wgcna_geneMap.rds"))
```


## 3. Trait matrix

```{r trait_matrix}
master_samples <- readRDS(out_data("master_samples.rds"))
ms <- master_samples[match(rownames(datExpr), master_samples$barcode), ]
stopifnot(identical(ms$barcode, rownames(datExpr)))

is_tumor <- ms$sample_group == "Tumor"
stage_trait <- function(stage) {
  x <- as.numeric(ms$Stage_Grouped == stage)          # NA for unstaged tumors
  x[!is_tumor] <- if (isTRUE(wg$stage_traits_tumor_only)) NA else 0
  x
}

traits <- data.frame(
  Tumor_Status = as.numeric(is_tumor),
  Stage_I      = stage_trait("Stage I"),
  Stage_II     = stage_trait("Stage II"),
  Stage_III    = stage_trait("Stage III"),
  Stage_IV     = stage_trait("Stage IV"),
  HPV_Pos      = as.numeric(ms$Final_HPV_Status == "Positive"),   # NA for NAT (Module 1)
  row.names    = ms$barcode
)

# Mutation flags: NA for NAT and for tumors without mutation data (Module 1)
for (g in cfg$mutations$flag_genes) {
  traits[[paste0(g, "_Mut")]] <- as.numeric(ms[[paste0(g, "_mutant")]])
}

# Expression traits from the full Module 2 matrix (not limited to network genes)
expr_all <- readRDS(out_data("v_mrna.rds"))$E
for (sym in wg$expression_traits) {
  ens <- gene_annotation$Ensembl_ID[gene_annotation$Symbol == sym]
  if (length(ens) != 1) stop("Expression trait ", sym, " maps to ", length(ens), " Ensembl IDs.")
  if (!ens %in% rownames(expr_all)) stop("Expression trait ", sym, " (", ens,
                                         ") did not pass filterByExpr in Module 2.")
  traits[[paste0(sym, "_Expr")]] <- expr_all[ens, rownames(datExpr)]
  cat(sym, "(", ens, ") in network gene set:", ens %in% colnames(datExpr), "\n")
}
rm(expr_all)

cat("\nTrait matrix:", nrow(traits), "samples x", ncol(traits), "traits\n")
cat("Non-missing samples per trait:\n")
print(colSums(!is.na(traits)))
saveRDS(traits, out_data("wgcna_traits.rds"))
```


## 4. Module-trait correlations

```{r trait_heatmap}
cp <- corAndPvalue(MEs, traits, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

mt_long <- data.frame(
  Module = rep(rownames(cp$cor), times = ncol(cp$cor)),
  Trait  = rep(colnames(cp$cor), each = nrow(cp$cor)),
  r      = as.vector(cp$cor),
  p      = as.vector(cp$p),
  n      = as.vector(cp$nObs)
)
write.csv(mt_long, file.path(wgcna_dir, "module_trait_correlations.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

draw_trait_heatmap <- function(trait_cols, main) {
  r <- cp$cor[, trait_cols, drop = FALSE]
  p <- cp$p[, trait_cols, drop = FALSE]
  text_mat <- matrix(paste0(signif(r, 2), "\n(", signif(p, 1), ")"), nrow = nrow(r))
  par(mar = c(10, 10, 4, 3))
  labeledHeatmap(Matrix = r, xLabels = trait_cols, yLabels = rownames(r),
                 ySymbols = rownames(r), colorLabels = FALSE,
                 colors = blueWhiteRed(50), textMatrix = text_mat,
                 setStdMargins = FALSE, cex.text = 0.6, cex.lab = 0.9,
                 zlim = c(-1, 1), main = main)
}

n_text <- sprintf("%d samples (%d tumor, %d NAT); n per trait in module_trait_correlations.csv",
                  nrow(traits), sum(is_tumor), sum(!is_tumor))

pdf(file.path(wgcna_dir, "Trait_Heatmap.pdf"), width = max(10, 0.8 * ncol(traits) + 4), height = 11)
draw_trait_heatmap(colnames(traits), paste("Module-trait correlations:", n_text))
invisible(dev.off())

key_traits <- c("Tumor_Status", "Stage_I", "Stage_II", "Stage_III", "Stage_IV",
                paste0(wg$expression_traits, "_Expr"))
pdf(file.path(wgcna_dir, "Trait_Heatmap_Key.pdf"), width = 10, height = 11)
draw_trait_heatmap(key_traits, "Module-trait correlations (key traits)")
invisible(dev.off())
draw_trait_heatmap(key_traits, "Module-trait correlations (key traits)")
```


## 5. Eigengene trajectories (Normal through Stage IV)

Wilcoxon p-values (Normal vs Stage I; Stage I vs Stage IV) are uncorrected and
descriptive.

```{r trajectories}
stage_levels <- c("Normal", "Stage I", "Stage II", "Stage III", "Stage IV")
plot_data <- data.frame(MEs, Barcode = rownames(MEs), check.names = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Group = ifelse(is_tumor, ms$Stage_Grouped, "Normal")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = stage_levels))
n_counts <- plot_data %>% dplyr::count(Group) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Label = paste0(Group, "\n(n=", n, ")"))
plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  dplyr::left_join(n_counts[, c("Group", "Label")], by = "Group") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Label = factor(Label, levels = n_counts$Label))
comparisons_traj <- list(levels(plot_data$Label)[c(1, 2)], levels(plot_data$Label)[c(2, 5)])

dark_modules <- c("blue", "black", "brown", "red", "magenta", "purple", "green",
                  "midnightblue", "turquoise", "darkred", "darkgreen", "darkblue")
plot_list <- lapply(colnames(MEs), function(me) {
  col <- sub("^ME", "", me)
  ggplot(dplyr::mutate(plot_data, ModuleLabel = me), aes(x = Label, y = .data[[me]], fill = Label)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, width = 0.6) +
    stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "line", aes(group = 1), color = "black") +
    stat_compare_means(comparisons = comparisons_traj, label = "p.signif",
                       method = "wilcox.test", vjust = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey80", "#FDDBC7", "#F4A582", "#D6604D", "#B2182B")) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9, face = "bold"),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = col),
          strip.text = element_text(color = if (col %in% dark_modules) "white" else "black",
                                    face = "bold", size = 11)) +
    labs(y = "Eigengene") +
    facet_wrap(~ ModuleLabel)
})
pdf(file.path(wgcna_dir, "Stage_Trajectories.pdf"), width = 18,
    height = 4 * ceiling(length(plot_list) / 4))
print(plot_grid(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = 4))
invisible(dev.off())
```


## 6. HPV confounder check

Wilcoxon p-values are uncorrected and descriptive.

```{r hpv_confounder}
hpv_long <- data.frame(MEs, check.names = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(HPV_Group = dplyr::case_when(
    !is_tumor                          ~ "Normal",
    ms$Final_HPV_Status == "Negative"  ~ "Tumor (HPV-)",
    ms$Final_HPV_Status == "Positive"  ~ "Tumor (HPV+)",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(HPV_Group)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(HPV_Group = factor(HPV_Group, levels = c("Normal", "Tumor (HPV-)", "Tumor (HPV+)"))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::starts_with("ME"), names_to = "Module", values_to = "Eigengene")

cat("Samples per HPV group:\n")
print(table(hpv_long$HPV_Group) / ncol(MEs))

p_hpv <- ggplot(hpv_long, aes(x = HPV_Group, y = Eigengene, fill = HPV_Group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, width = 0.6) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("Normal", "Tumor (HPV-)"), c("Normal", "Tumor (HPV+)"),
                                        c("Tumor (HPV-)", "Tumor (HPV+)")),
                     label = "p.signif", method = "wilcox.test", size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ Module, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Normal" = "grey80", "Tumor (HPV-)" = "#E66101",
                               "Tumor (HPV+)" = "#5E3C99")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9, face = "bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  labs(title = "Module eigengenes by HPV status", y = "Eigengene")
pdf(file.path(wgcna_dir, "HPV_Confounder.pdf"), width = 18, height = 16)
print(p_hpv)
invisible(dev.off())

hpv_effect <- hpv_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Module, HPV_Group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Median_ME = median(Eigengene), n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = HPV_Group, values_from = c(Median_ME, n))
write.csv(hpv_effect, file.path(wgcna_dir, "HPV_Effect_Sizes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```


## 7. Pathway enrichment per module

```{r pathways}
entrez_all <- suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
  bitr(gene_map$Ensembl_ID, fromType = "ENSEMBL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)))
# One Entrez ID per Ensembl ID (first match), so no gene is counted twice
n_multi <- sum(table(entrez_all$ENSEMBL) > 1)
entrez_map <- entrez_all[!duplicated(entrez_all$ENSEMBL), ]
cat("Ensembl IDs with >1 Entrez match (first kept):", n_multi, "\n")
universe <- unique(entrez_map$ENTREZID)
cat("Background: ", length(universe), " Entrez IDs from ",
    dplyr::n_distinct(entrez_map$ENSEMBL), " of ", nrow(gene_map), " network genes\n", sep = "")

enrich_summary <- list()
for (mod in setdiff(unique(gene_map$Module), "grey")) {
  mod_ens <- gene_map$Ensembl_ID[gene_map$Module == mod]
  entrez <- unique(entrez_map$ENTREZID[entrez_map$ENSEMBL %in% mod_ens])
  if (length(entrez) == 0) next

  ego <- enrichGO(gene = entrez, universe = universe, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                  ont = "BP", pAdjustMethod = "BH", readable = TRUE)
  ekegg <- tryCatch(enrichKEGG(gene = entrez, universe = universe, organism = "hsa"),
                    error = function(e) { message("KEGG failed for ", mod, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
  ereact <- tryCatch(enrichPathway(gene = entrez, universe = universe, organism = "human", readable = TRUE),
                     error = function(e) { message("Reactome failed for ", mod, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })

  n_terms <- function(x) if (is.null(x)) NA_integer_ else nrow(as.data.frame(x))
  enrich_summary[[mod]] <- data.frame(Module = mod, Genes = length(mod_ens), Entrez = length(entrez),
                                      GO_BP = n_terms(ego), KEGG = n_terms(ekegg), Reactome = n_terms(ereact))

  for (res in list(list(ego, "GO_BP"), list(ekegg, "KEGG"), list(ereact, "Reactome"))) {
    if (!is.null(res[[1]]) && nrow(as.data.frame(res[[1]])) > 0) {
      write.table(as.data.frame(res[[1]]), file.path(pathway_dir, paste0(mod, "_", res[[2]], ".txt")),
                  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
    }
  }
  if (!is.null(ego) && nrow(as.data.frame(ego)) > 0) {
    pdf(file.path(pathway_dir, paste0(mod, "_GO_Dotplot.pdf")), width = 12, height = 10)
    print(dotplot(ego, showCategory = 10) + ggtitle(paste(mod, "module: GO BP")) +
            theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 12), plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")))
    invisible(dev.off())
  }
}
cat("\nSignificant terms per module (BH-adjusted, clusterProfiler defaults):\n")
print(dplyr::bind_rows(enrich_summary), row.names = FALSE)
```


## 8. Hub genes

```{r hubs}
hub_threshold <- wg$hub_kme_threshold
hubs <- gene_map %>%
  dplyr::filter(Module != "grey", kME > hub_threshold) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(kME_threshold = hub_threshold) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Module, dplyr::desc(kME))
write.csv(hubs, file.path(wgcna_dir, "Hub_genes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("Hub genes (kME >", hub_threshold, "):", nrow(hubs), "across",
    dplyr::n_distinct(hubs$Module), "modules\n")
print(table(hubs$Module))
```


```{r cleanup_and_session_info}
rm(datKME, cp, mt_long, plot_data, plot_list, hpv_long, p_hpv, entrez_all, entrez_map, enrich_summary)
invisible(gc())
stop_log()
```
